environment: Fixed child environment allowlist in bundled mcp_client.py; no credentials forwarded
process: Configured Python interpreter and runtime.mcp_server stdio child; trusted Windows DLP also invokes the fixed ACL helper
output_guard: Trusted DLP reads fixed policy, stages generated text in restricted quarantine and invokes only the fixed Windows ACL helper with a fixed directory argument. None of these are model-callable tools. Owner CLI can inspect and delete inert evidence.
network: Only fixed Ollama /api/chat, /api/tags and /api/ps routes at literal IPv4 loopback port 11434; no proxies or redirects. Production rootless Podman pod has network=none and no published inference ports.
enforcement_limit: The fixed WSL2/rootless Podman executor validates readonly images, mounts and namespaces; behavior probes verify external/LAN/DNS denial. This does not prove every side channel or semantic prompt-injection defense.
knowledge: Trusted runtime reads only the hash-pinned /app/knowledge/approved.sqlite image file. All configured personas can retrieve approved documents, with a modest relevance-based preference for their role. Bounded evidence is untrusted data, never instructions. No browsing or filesystem tool is exposed.
